top_violation_types.title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §747.3501(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An above the ground pool was observed accesible to students.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver did not practice fire drill monthly since 01/2022.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1801)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A total of one caregiver and ten children were observed inside the licensed childcare home. The maximum children allowed is seven children based on their age group. The licensed childcare home is out of ratio by three children.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §747.1503(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During an investigation, it was determined an infant was placed in a play yard in another room unsupervised and sustained minor injuries.

top_violation_types.title: Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (26 TAC §747.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregivers record lacked a notarized affidavit.

top_violation_types.title: AP Never exceed capacity of the home (26 TAC §747.207(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation was observed caring for thirteen children. The capacity on the permit is 12.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.
